programs.title: Last Knights
programs.desc: (2015) Action adventure with Clive Owen and Morgan Freeman. A medieval warrior emerges from exile to seek vengeance for his noble master, igniting a battle that will decide the fate of the kingdom.

programs.title: Predestination
programs.desc: (2015) Sci-fi action with Ethan Hawke and Succession's Sarah Snook. A temporal agent who stops crimes before they happen is tasked with catching a fugitive who's always one step ahead in time.

programs.title: Hellgate
programs.desc: (1952) Western starring Sterling Hayden. After the Civil War a rancher is wrongfully imprisoned in a notorious desert prison. When a deadly plague threatens to overwhelm the jail, can he help stop it?

programs.title: Panhandle
programs.desc: (1948) Western starring Rod Cameron. A former Texas marshal is determined to prove a powerful casino owner is behind his brother's murder.
